name: This Is How We Break Through

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage and push it 1 unit.

surges.html: Move into its vacated space after a hit.
On a hit, suppress 1 point of its equipment Fortitude against the next attack until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or an ally within 3 units crosses the target's former space before your next turn: that creature becomes Rallied.
